article_title: Incorporating Early Learning Strategies in the School Improvement Grants (SIG) Program: How Three Schools Integrated Early Childhood Strategies into School Turnaround Efforts to Improve Instruction for All Students
citation: Connors-Tadros, L., Dunn, L., Martella, J., & McCauley, C. (2015). Incorporating early learning strategies in the School Improvement Grants (SIG) program: How three schools integrated early childhood strategies into school turnaround efforts to improve instruction for all students. New Brunswick, NJ: National Institute for Early Education Research. https://www.nieer.org
title: Boston Public Schools early learning strategy: uniform early math and literacy curricula, teacher training, coaches, and NAEYC accreditation support
description: Boston Public Schools enlists early childhood programming in its achievement acceleration agenda by "implementing uniform mathematics and literacy programs across early learning programs and including teacher training and coaches." Under early childhood director Jason Sachs, BPS expanded full-day kindergarten to every five year old, moved 35 schools toward NAEYC accreditation, and supported Orchard Gardens, which attained accreditation for its preschool and kindergarten classrooms in 2011 with the highest scores in the district. Internal and independent studies reveal positive effects on student performance in both the short and long terms.
requirements: District investment in uniform standards and curricula in math and literacy, expanded teacher training, and use of instructional coaches
constraints: The yearlong NAEYC accreditation process is described as rigorous and intensive
target_learners: Four-year-old preschoolers and kindergartners in a large urban district, including English language learners and students with disabilities
target_learning_goals: Improved early literacy and mathematics learning supporting short- and long-term achievement
examples: Orchard Gardens revitalized its K0–K2 curricula and implemented new reading and math frameworks school-wide with BPS early childhood supports
